_comment: TokenService (Infrastructure/Security/TokenService.cs) reads JwtSettings:Secret directly with no fallback of its own — unlike Program.cs's Bearer-validation setup, an empty value here throws when actually signing a token, not just when validating one. This value is Development-only and safe to commit (same reasoning as EcfXmlSigner's dummy-certificate fallback); every other environment must set a real one via User Secrets / env var / secret store and fails to start otherwise.
_ecfEmisorComment: EcfEmisorOptions' RNC-format ValidateOnStart() is NOT Development-gated (RNC identity isn't a secret the way JwtSettings:Secret/WorkerSecretKey are) — the base appsettings.json is deliberately blank, so local Development needs its own real value here or the host won't start at all, even locally. Real company RNC, not a placeholder.
